name: add carries into CY
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.movi r4,1
b.add r6,r3,r4
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: add does not carry
asm:
b.movi r3,1
b.movi r4,1
b.add r6,r3,r4
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: addi carries
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.addi r6,r3,1
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: sub borrows
asm:
b.movi r4,1
b.sub r6,r0,r4
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: sub does not borrow
asm:
b.movi r4,1
b.sub r6,r4,r0
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: addc chains a carry
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.movi r4,1
b.add r5,r3,r4
b.addc r6,r3,r0
b.addc r20,r0,r0

name: subb takes the borrow
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.movi r4,1
b.add r5,r3,r4
b.movi r7,0
b.subb r6,r7,r0

name: 64-bit add, low carries
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.movi r4,-1
b.movi r5,1
b.movi r6,0
b.add r7,r3,r5
b.addc r8,r4,r6

name: movhi + addi address
asm:
b.movhi r3,0x15
b.addi r6,r3,0x10

name: movhi + ori address
asm:
b.movhi r3,0x15
b.ori r6,r3,0x25d0

name: movhi + negative addi
asm:
b.movhi r3,0x1234
b.addi r6,r3,-0x5678

name: shifts
asm:
b.movi r3,-16
b.slli r6,r3,2
b.srli r7,r3,4
b.srai r8,r3,4

name: rotate
asm:
b.movi r3,-16
b.movi r4,8
b.ror r6,r3,r4

name: logic
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.movi r4,0x5
b.and r6,r3,r4
b.or r7,r0,r4
b.xor r8,r3,r4
b.nand r9,r3,r4

name: logic immediates
asm:
b.movi r3,-1
b.andi r6,r3,0x0f
b.ori r7,r0,0x0f
b.xori r8,r3,0x0f

name: sign and zero extension
asm:
b.movhi r3,0x1234
b.ori r3,r3,0x80ff
b.extbz r6,r3
b.extbs r7,r3
b.exthz r8,r3
b.exths r9,r3

name: multiply, low word
asm:
b.movhi r3,1
b.mul r6,r3,r3
b.movi r4,-3
b.movi r5,5
b.mul r7,r4,r5

name: divide
asm:
b.addi r3,r0,-20
b.movi r4,5
b.div r6,r3,r4
b.addi r5,r0,20
b.divu r7,r5,r4

name: compare sets the flag
asm:
b.movi r3,5
b.movi r4,7
b.sfleu r3,r4
b.cmov r6,r3,r4

name: compare, false case
asm:
b.movi r3,9
b.movi r4,7
b.sfleu r3,r4
b.cmov r6,r3,r4

name: find first/last one
asm:
b.movhi r3,0x8000
b.ori r3,r3,0x10
b.ff1 r6,r3
b.fl1 r7,r3

name: store then load word
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r5,r0,0x7b
b.sw 0x10(r1),r5
b.lwz r6,0x10(r1)

name: store then load byte
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.movi r5,-1
b.sb 0x14(r1),r5
b.lbz r6,0x14(r1)
b.lbs r7,0x14(r1)

name: store then load half
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.movi r5,-2
b.sh 0x18(r1),r5
b.lhz r6,0x18(r1)
b.lhs r7,0x18(r1)

name: word store, byte loads
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.movhi r5,0x1122
b.ori r5,r5,0x3344
b.sw 0x10(r1),r5
b.lbz r6,0x10(r1)
b.lbz r7,0x13(r1)
b.lhz r8,0x10(r1)

name: half store, byte load
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.ori r5,r0,0xa1b2
b.sh 0x18(r1),r5
b.lbz r6,0x18(r1)
b.lbz r7,0x19(r1)

name: push and pop move r1
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r5,r0,0x2a
b.push r5
b.pop r6

name: conditional move, taken
asm:
b.movi r3,1
b.movi r4,2
b.sfeq r3,r3
b.cmov r6,r3,r4

name: msw stores 2 registers
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r3,r0,0x33
b.addi r4,r0,0x44
b.msw 0x0(r1),r3,0x0
b.lwz r6,0x0(r1)
b.lwz r7,0x4(r1)

name: msw stores 4 registers
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r3,r0,0x33
b.addi r4,r0,0x44
b.addi r5,r0,0x55
b.addi r6,r0,0x66
b.msw 0x0(r1),r3,0x2
b.lwz r7,0x8(r1)
b.lwz r8,0xc(r1)

name: mlwz loads 3 registers
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r3,r0,0x33
b.addi r4,r0,0x44
b.addi r5,r0,0x55
b.msw 0x0(r1),r3,0x1
b.mlwz r6,0x0(r1),0x1

name: divl shifts then divides
asm:
b.addi r3,r0,100
b.addi r4,r0,8
.byte 0xa0
.byte 0xc3
.byte 0x20
.byte 0x40

name: divl rounds half up
asm:
b.addi r3,r0,7
b.addi r4,r0,2
.byte 0xa0
.byte 0xc3
.byte 0x20
.byte 0x01

name: divl rounds negatives
asm:
b.addi r3,r0,-7
b.addi r4,r0,2
.byte 0xa0
.byte 0xc3
.byte 0x20
.byte 0x01

name: mlwz offset scales by 4
asm:
b.movhi r1,0x10
b.addi r3,r0,0x33
b.addi r4,r0,0x44
b.msw 0x4(r1),r3,0x0
b.mlwz r6,0x4(r1),0x0
